definitionZh: 溢出区块 CSS 属性设定了内容溢出区块起始和块尾边缘时显示的内容 。 这可能是什么,一个卷轴条,或溢出的内容。
sourceDefinition: The overflow-block CSS property sets what shows when content overflows the block start and block end edges of a box. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The overflow-block CSS property sets what shows when content overflows the block start and block end edges of a box. This may be nothing, a scroll bar, or the overflow content.
